name: webui
description: Web UI for agent interaction — login, chat, session management

enabled.description: Whether this extension is enabled. Set to false to disable the extension entirely.

host.description: WebUI server host. Loopback by default; set 0.0.0.0 explicitly to expose beyond localhost.

sessionTokenTtlMin.description: Session token TTL in minutes (default: 24 hours)

trustedProxy.description: Reverse proxy IP or CIDR whose x-forwarded-for header the login rate limiter may believe (e.g. "127.0.0.1" or "10.0.0.0/8"). Empty (default): x-forwarded-for is never believed and the throttle keys on the direct socket peer; see docs/config-reference.md.

cli:subcommands.name: webui
cli:subcommands.description: Start the WebUI server (HTTP + WebSocket + frontend)
